docs.title: What is Textevo ?
docs.text:
Textevo is a text animation tool for after effects. It is mainly useful to break down text animation letters by letters, words by words or lines by lines.

Textevo automatically adds a text animation group and a control effect:

The "strength" parameter is used to adjust the overall intensity of the effect. You will animate it to your liking and the instances (letters, words, lines) of the text will follow with the delay you have set.

You can add as many textevo effects on your text layer. You will be able to animate your texts with a lot of freedom, to add arrival and departure movements as well as intermediate animations.

docs.title: What's new ?
docs.text:
• A light and flexible interface
  • An effect grouping the main parameters
  • Ability to stack effects for more freedom
  • More animation directions ( random , outwards , inwards etc... )
  • A preset system

And lots of other little options

docs.title: Controls
docs.text: This version of textevo has been designed to be simple. The textevo controls have been combined in a pseudo effect :

docs.title: Strength
docs.text:
This parameter controls the intensity of textevo.

This is the parameter you need to animate if you want to add motion to your text.

You have the possibility to add bounce expressions, elasticity, wiggle, sinusoid etc... (work with duik , ease an wizz and your favorite scripts).

docs.title: Direction
docs.text: You have a choice of different directions of animation :

docs.title: From index
docs.text: This parameter works with the "from index" direction and allows you to choose from which index the animation starts.

docs.title: Random seed
docs.text: This parameter works with the "random" direction. Changing the Seed value will result in entirely different random values.

docs.title: Transform
docs.text:
Gives access to the different transformation properties. These properties affect the text relatively. They are directly impacted by the "strength" parameter.

Example:

If you have set the Y position to 100 and the strength is 50%, your text will only be affected by 50 px on Y.

docs.title: Style
docs.text: Works like the transform but with different properties

docs.title: Why have a rename and delete button?
docs.text:
A Textevo is made of an effect and a text animator linked by expressions. After Effects does not tell scripts when you delete or rename an effect by hand, so Textevo cannot fix things up afterwards:

  • deleting the effect by hand leaves its text animator on the layer, with expression errors: delete it by hand too, or better, use the Remove button;
  • renaming the effect by hand updates the expressions but not the name of the text animator: use the Rename button to keep both names in sync.

docs.title: Why is the "Based On" function not included in the effect ?
docs.text: This option can't be controlled by expressions, that's why the option is on the script panel .

docs.title: Why is the color fill option not available in the effect ?
docs.text: If this parameter was included it would override the text color without being disabled. But you can still add it manually and it will work with textevo if you add it in the right animation group.

docs.title: How do I add effects or properties such as shadows, controls, noise etc. to my presets?
docs.text: Unfortunately you cannot use the textevo preset panel. You have to select the content of your textevo animations, effects and properties and then save your animations with the after effects preset tool.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Go through Edit -> Preferences -> General. A window will open with a bunch of checkboxes, where you can enable “Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network”.

docs.title: CC2019+
docs.text:
File > Scripts > Install Script UI Panel

and select "textevo.jsx"

docs.title: CC2018 and earlier
docs.text:
*Lloyd Alvarez tutoriel : https://youtu.be/EIm0Sa6noOk *

Copy "textevo.jsx" to ScriptUI Panels folder:

Windows:

C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects CC/Support Files/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels/

Mac OS:

/Applications/Adobe After Effects CC/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels

docs.title: Interface
docs.text: Textevo's interface is responsive and flexible, you can adjust it vertically or horizontally.

docs.title: Add
docs.text:
Click = adds textvo to your selected texts.

Alt + Click = adds Textevo but with inverted keyframes (useful for an output animation for example)

If no layer is selected textvo will generate a text layer automatically.
(in active composition).

Always use the Remove and Rename buttons

A Textevo is made of two parts: the Textevo effect and a text animator on the text layer, linked by expressions. Removing or renaming the effect by hand only changes one of the two parts. Use the Remove and Rename buttons of the panel, which handle both.

docs.title: Remove
docs.text:
Deletes one or all instances of textvo, depending on whether an effect or layer(s) is selected.

The effect and its text animator are removed. If you delete the effect by hand, its text animator stays on the layer with expression errors, and has to be deleted by hand too.

docs.title: Rename
docs.text:
Renames the selected Textevo effect and its text animator together.

If you rename the effect by hand, After Effects updates the expressions but not the name of the text animator, so the effect and its animator no longer have the same name in the timeline.

docs.title: Based on
docs.text: This opens a window with options allowing you to choose whether the animation will be split by letters, letters spacesless, words or lines.

docs.title: the "Auto adapt the delay" checkbox
docs.text: Adjusts the delay according to the number of instances. For example switching from a 12 letter animation to 3 words will adjust the delay with a ratio of 4 (12 / 3).

docs.title: Toggle 2d/3d
docs.text: Activate and deactivate 3d per character

docs.title: Copy
docs.text: Copies all the Textevo or only the selected ones.

docs.title: Paste
docs.text:
Paste the textevo(s) you previously copied on the selected layer(s).

Click = the keyframes keep their position from the in point of the layer: a key on the first frame of the copied layer lands on the first frame of the target layer.

Alt + Click = the first keyframe lands at the current time.

docs.title: Presets
docs.text:
Click = Opens a preset management window. Shift + click = saves the current selection as a preset.

In the presets window, apply (or a double click) applies the preset from the in point of the layer. Alt + click (or Alt + double click) puts the first keyframe at the current time.

docs.title: Presets saved with an older version
docs.text: Presets saved before Textevo 2026 stored their keyframes from the start of the composition, so they could land far after the text layer, sometimes outside of the composition. When the presets window opens, Textevo detects them and offers to update them so they start at the in point of the layer. A copy of the original files is kept in the backup_before_2026 folder of your presets.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Opens the configuration window. You can change the default behaviors.
